items.headline: US Treasury Chief to Meet Chinese Counterpart Ahead of High-Stakes Summit
items.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced he will hold high-level talks with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng this weekend to prepare for an upcoming Washington summit between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping. The negotiations will focus on bilateral trade, artificial intelligence safety, and enforcement of Iran sanctions, making this a pivotal diplomatic moment for global markets.

items.headline: US Formally Confirms Deployment of Weapons in Earth Orbit
items.summary: For the first time, U.S. military officials confirmed that the nation has active space-control weapons deployed in Earth's orbit. The unprecedented public admission sparked immediate warnings from international rivals regarding a potential orbital arms race.

items.headline: UEFA Selects Munich and Barcelona to Host 2028 and 2029 Champions League Finals
items.summary: On September 15, 2026, UEFA's Executive Committee announced that Munich's Allianz Arena will host the 2028 Champions League final, while Barcelona's renovated Camp Nou was selected for the 2029 final. The announcement is major international news as European football's governing body locked in key venues for its flagship club competitions.

items.headline: "Widow's Bay" and "The Pitt" Win Big at 78th Primetime Emmy Awards
items.summary: The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards took place in Los Angeles, with medical drama "The Pitt" and comedy-horror series "Widow's Bay" taking top show honors. The ceremony made history as actor Matthew Rhys became the first performer to win two lead acting trophies in a single night.
